notes: Country determination: Germany (Hamburg) - certainty HIGH. Cues: German-language banners 'SAG JA ZU KLIMASCHUTZ' and 'HAMBURGER ZUKUNFTSENTSCHEID' on the balcony, Gruenderzeit brick/stucco villa architecture, slate roof, historic double entry door with transom. Calc profile DE.

Building age: pre-1918 Gruenderzeit villa. Per DE table, door-based scale chains are treated as [statistical] and cross-checked against balcony railing (standardized ~1000 mm) and exterior stair risers.
Triage labeled both photos 'front'; corrected here: photo 1 is the garden/back elevation (woodpile, rain barrel, rear stair), photo 2 is the street/front elevation (fence, house number 256).

Photo 1 estimated yaw ~10 deg (eave/plinth line convergence); apparent widths divided by cos(10)=0.985. Photo 2 estimated yaw ~5 deg; width correction cos(5)=0.996. Photo 2 has significant upward pitch - vertical chains from photo 2 are compressed and capped at low reliability.
Photo 1: right facade corner lies within the outer 10% of the frame - possible wide-angle compression at that corner.
The cross-gable wing runs the full building depth (gable visible at back-left in photo 1 and front-right in photo 2 - same wing, viewed from opposite sides).
Datum: grade zero at the front (street) facade base. Back grade is ~600 mm lower (8 rear stair risers vs ~4 front steps).
